# ArrLink

> ArrLink is an AI-accelerated software development company. We build custom software, generative AI applications, AI agents, SaaS products, MVPs, data platforms and web/mobile apps for startups and enterprises worldwide.

## Services
- Generative AI development: LLM apps, RAG copilots, custom-trained models
- AI agents & automation: chatbots, voice bots, workflow agents integrated with CRM and WhatsApp
- Custom software development: web platforms, internal tools, enterprise systems
- SaaS & MVP development: idea to production MVP in 4–8 weeks, then multi-tenant SaaS
- Data engineering & analytics: pipelines, warehouses, dashboards
- Web & mobile app development: websites and cross-platform iOS/Android apps

## Selected work
- Imagine.bo (Synergylabs): prompt-to-production AI app builder
- Krinos AI: HIPAA-compliant AI dental diagnostics platform
- Mythyaverse: ECG arrhythmia prediction model
- Sharda University: ML fake-review detection via network-traffic analysis

## Industries
Healthcare, finance & fintech, e-commerce & retail, logistics & supply chain, education, manufacturing.
